title: CatBud Mod(unofficial)
description: 中文:這是一個適用於貓芽伺服器的輔助模組|English:This is an auxiliary module for the Catbud server.
body:
這是一個專為[貓芽](<https://catbud.net>)伺服器設計的輔助模組，提供快捷指令、聊天頻道切換以及自訂指令按鈕等便利功能，讓玩家能更快
速地使用伺服器功能。

- 可一鍵執行指令
- 切換聊天頻道
- 本模組僅針對[貓芽](<https://catbud.net>)伺服器進行設計與測試，其他伺服器可能無法正常運作。
<details>
<summary>English</summary>
This is an auxiliary module designed specifically for the [catbud](<https://catbud.net>) server, providing convenient functions such as shortcut commands, chat channel switching, and customizable command buttons, allowing players to use server functions more quickly.

- One-click command execution
- Switch chat channels
- This module is designed and tested only for the [catbud](<https://catbud.net>) server; it may not function properly on other servers.
